title: Hold a licence or registration to transport waste
what: Hold the environment regulator's licence, registration or permit before transporting controlled or regulated waste.

laws.title: Environmental Protection Act 1994 (Qld)
laws.provisions: s 426; Environmental Protection Regulation 2019 sch 2 s 57

sources.title: Environmental Protection Act 1994 (Qld)
sources.quote: 426 Environmental authority required for particular environmentally relevant activities (1) A person must not carry out an environmentally relevant activity unless the person holds, or is acting under, an environmental authority for the activity.

sources.title: Environmental Protection Regulation 2019 (Qld)
sources.quote: 57 Regulated waste transport (1) Regulated waste transport (the relevant activity ) consists of transporting regulated waste in a vehicle.
